title: Rails API Mode
intro: Rails API mode strips the view layer and middleware unnecessary for JSON APIs, giving you a lighter ActionController::API base class instead of ActionController::Base. Interviewers at API-first Rails shops probe the serialization decision hard — Jbuilder uses templates (slow but flexible), ActiveModelSerializer follows conventions (well-established but slow for large collections), jsonapi-serializer (formerly fast_jsonapi from Netflix) is the fastest option, and Alba is a newer performant alternative. This page covers the api-only setup, CORS with rack-cors, the serialization comparison and when to use each, API versioning strategies (URL namespace is the most common), pagination with Pagy (faster than Kaminari), and rate limiting with Rack::Attack.
